title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request here, for a deep dive. Day after the midterms: Democrats projected to control House and Senate.

sections.title: World
sections.body_md: US midterms overnight: major outlets project Democrats flipped both chambers — a decisive rebuke of Trump’s second-term GOP.

items.headline_md: **Democrats** win **House** and **Senate**, taking full control of Congress
items.summary_md: Ballotpedia (as of ~1:30 a.m. EST results cut): Democrats pick up ≥18 House seats and 7 Senate seats for at least a ~231–141 House and ~54–44 Senate majority; seven Trump-won states flipped Senate (IA, KS, ME, NC, OH, SC, TX).

items.headline_md: **Texas** elects Democrat **James Talarico** to Senate; **Gina Hinojosa** unseats Gov. Abbott
items.summary_md: Ballotpedia: Talarico beats Ken Paxton — first Democrat elected statewide in Texas since 1994 and first Democratic TX senator since 1988; Hinojosa defeats Greg Abbott — first Democratic TX governor win since Ann Richards in 1990.

items.headline_md: **South Carolina** elects Democrat **Annie Andrews**; **Michigan** elects **Abdul El-Sayed**
items.summary_md: Ballotpedia: Andrews beats Darline Graham — first Democratic SC senator since 1998. Separate MI result: El-Sayed defeats Mike Rogers (~52.4%–45.6% per election tallies reported Nov 4).

items.headline_md: **Spain** transport minister **Óscar Puente** resigns after Urda crash that killed **69**
items.summary_md: Puente quit Tuesday in Congress six days after the high-speed collision near Urda (Renfe into stationary Iryo); he also withdrew from Nov 29 election lists, citing two serious rail accidents in under a year.

items.headline_md: **Trump** blames Iran war/gas prices; Iran’s Ghalibaf calls vote “**NO TO WAR**”
items.summary_md: CNBC Morning Squawk: Trump said Iran war and gasoline prices partly drove GOP losses and told FT he has no immediate plans to strike Iran; Tehran parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said Americans said “NO TO WAR.”

items.headline_md: **Georgia:** **Keisha Lance Bottoms** elected first Black woman U.S. governor
items.summary_md: Ballotpedia: Bottoms defeats Rick Jackson — first Black woman elected governor in the U.S. and first Democrat elected Georgia governor since 1998; Dems also gain IA/OH/TX governorships for ≥27 Dem vs 20 GOP seats.

items.headline_md: **CVS Health** to split into two public companies by 1H **2028**
items.summary_md: CVS will separate Aetna/Caremark/Specialty/Oak Street/Signify (stays “CVS Health”) from ~9,000 pharmacies + MinuteClinic + Health100 (“CVS Pharmacy”); tax-free to shareholders intended; Joyner leads solutions co., Prem Shah leads Pharmacy.

items.headline_md: **AMD** Q3: revenue **$13.4B** (+45% YoY), non-GAAP EPS **$2.09**; data center nearly doubles
items.summary_md: AMD IR / StockTitan: Q3 revenue $13.377B; non-GAAP EPS $2.09 (+74%); Data Center record $8.546B (+97% YoY). CNBC: shares strong premarket; Lisa Su on Squawk on the Street 9 a.m. ET.

items.headline_md: **Euro area** inflation flash **4.0%** in October (from 3.8%) — energy **20.8%**
items.summary_md: Eurostat flash: euro-area HICP 4.0% YoY in Oct (3.8% in Sept); energy the hottest component at 20.8% (from 18.9%); monthly +0.4%.

items.headline_md: **Disney** readies more layoffs; some managers targeting up to **20%** savings
items.summary_md: Deadline (citing Bloomberg/sources): thousands may be cut across TV networks and the film studio after VERO; Disney ~230k employees end of last fiscal year; company declined comment.

items.headline_md: Futures rebound on Democratic sweep; **Tesla/SpaceX** pressured after Texas flips
items.summary_md: CNBC Morning Squawk (6:29 a.m. EST): Dow/S&P/Nasdaq futures rallied from overnight lows; dollar to a one-month low; Tesla and SpaceX heavy in premarket after Texas Senate/governor flips and Musk’s large GOP spend.

items.headline_md: **Genshin Impact** Version **7.2** “Hour of Ruin” live Nov 4 — eastern Snezhnaya
items.summary_md: AppGamer: Archon Quest summit in Snezhnaya; new rail-linked cities Novokitezhgrad/Old Kitezhgrad; new 5★ Electro Catalyst Mitya with Furina rerun; event window yields 560 Primogems if finished on time.

items.headline_md: **Brawl Stars** Nov 3 update: 3 new Brawlers + Ranked overhaul (unlock **5,000** trophies)
items.summary_md: Supercell adds Legendary Thunder Frogs plus Mythics Rey and Ruby; Ranked now needs Power 11, unlocks at 5k trophies (was 1k), six free maxed Brawlers/season, gentler resets; Mega Showdown (20p) and Counterlight added.

items.headline_md: **Pokémon GO:** November GO Pass live; **Altered Forme Giratina** raids Nov 4–8
items.summary_md: Free track includes Groudon + 400 coins; Deluxe $7.99; Raid Hour today 6–7pm local; Halloween Part II ends 8pm Nov 5.

items.headline_md: **Anipang 4** adds in-house Smart Match 3 engine + Haptic Play
items.summary_md: WEMADE PLAY: engine does ~1,000 puzzle sims/sec, tested on ~8,000 stages; eight vibration patterns; PD expects >200 puzzles/month (more than double prior).

items.headline_md: **Clash Royale** King vs King: Evo Giant + Evo Mirror; CRL Finals Shanghai Nov 6–8
items.summary_md: Evo Giant leaves a Rage trail when enraged; Evo Mirror copies last card’s Evolution (or acts like Mirror); Daily Puzzles through Nov 8.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md:
**Wii U lifter watch:** Early-Oct r/decomps PowerPC→x86 claim (Mario 3D World / MK8 / NSMBU / Splatoon / BOTW) still has **no newly public “when stable” GitHub drop** today. Separate tools (CafeRecomp last push ~Oct 18; nWiiURecomp idle since Aug) are **not** that release. Reddit r/decomps + r/emulation blocked this run (network policy); GitHub/web search used instead.

**Watch notes:** KytyPS5 only shipped routine Nov 3–4 nightlies (font/save-mount) — not a gameplay milestone. No verified 24–48h breakthrough for Kirikae, AnyPS5 Astro Bot, RE4 GameCube→PC, or Wind Waker HD beyond prior devel build.

items.headline_md: Update: **LASRecomp** posts **test-beta6-preview** (Nov 3) + **test-574-snow** (Nov 4) — still not stable
items.summary_md: Beta 6 WIP test build for feedback, plus a snow/autumn ground-tile cosmetic test (#574/#575/#577). Official latest remains beta_5.4; authors warn not for general use — still not crash-free stable.

items.headline_md: **Super Smash Bros. for Wii U** — Smash 4 PC recomp **v0.1.2** (Windows)
items.summary_md: AllRecomps detects Nov 4 USA Wii U static recomp with local multiplayer and beta streaming netplay; original online still needs Pretendo. Own dump required.

items.headline_md: **Pokémon Brilliant Diamond/Shining Pearl** Strahlender installer **v0.1.5** (Switch→PC/macOS/iOS)
items.summary_md: AllRecomps Nov 4: static Switch recomp with local installers including Mac-built iPhone/iPad apps; own data required; iOS signing/experimental ARM Linux caveats apply.

items.headline_md: **Melee Unlocked** **v0.9.98** — Melee decomp source port + separate static recomp engine
items.summary_md: AllRecomps Nov 4: NTSC 1.02 ISO, Slippi integration, 60 Hz logic decoupled from display; Linux included. PC-focused Melee stack.

items.headline_md: AllRecomps Nov 4 PC wave: **Mushihimesama Futari** v1.5.5, **Sonic Free Riders** v0.10.45, **ICO** native v0.10.1, more
items.summary_md: Notable PC detections today also include WWE SvR 2011 v2.1.9, F-Zero X v0.1.6, Rush 2 N64 v1.0.41. One-line Switch-hardware ports skipped.

items.headline_md: Weekend 44 hold: **You Can See Everything** $11.45M narrowly tops **Clayface** $11.00M; **Wildwood** $8.95M
items.summary_md: Box Office Mojo (Oct 30–Nov 1): A24 doc $11,445,629 (cume $64.7M); Clayface $11,002,116 ($44.7M); Wildwood $8,949,324 ($27.4M); Wicker $4.36M; Street Fighter $3.66M.

items.headline_md: **You Can See Everything** (Fielder/Holmes doc) **96%/96%** RT — first doc #1 since Fahrenheit 9/11 era buzz
items.summary_md: Rotten Tomatoes: 96% Tomatometer (206) / 96% Popcornmeter; A24 wide since Oct 16; Nathan Fielder & Lance Oppenheim direct Elizabeth Holmes portrait.

items.headline_md: Friday Nov 6 wide: **The Cat in the Hat**, **Godzilla Minus Zero**, **Wild Horse Nine**, more
items.summary_md: TheMovieBox/BOM calendar: Bill Hader’s Cat in the Hat and Takashi Yamazaki’s Godzilla Minus Zero headline; also Wild Horse Nine, Jimmy, Drummer Boy, Ramayana: Rise of a Legend among the week’s slate.

items.headline_md: Tracking: **Cat in the Hat** ~$25–45M OW range; **Godzilla Minus Zero** ~$23–35M — neck-and-neck No. 1 fight
items.summary_md: Box Office Theory / Boxoffice Pro / ComicBasics tracking clusters both tentpoles in the mid-$20Ms to low-$40Ms depending on source; competition for weekend crown expected.

items.headline_md: Wed limited: **The Last Temptation of Becky**, **Trauma or, Monsters All**, **Rammstein: Live in Mexico City**
items.summary_md: BOM/TheMovieBox Nov 4 theatrical adds include those titles plus De Gaulle: Resistance; Rocky 50th anniversary returns Nov 7.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI:** ChatGPT search volume = **~20%** of Google’s — ads expanding
items.summary_md: Verge (Nov 3): consumer lead Adam Fry said ChatGPT web-search queries equal about one-fifth of Google’s volume; company defending ads and adding sponsored product images.

items.headline_md: **Google** will cut student **Search** unless schools opt into AI (Guided Learning)
items.summary_md: 9to5Google (Nov 3): Gemini + Search off by default for K–12 until admins enable; Google says Search/AI are integrated so fully disabling AI also disables Search; Guided Learning pilot this month, broader early 2027.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** amended S-1: ~**$17B** Q3 revenue; **$895.4B** compute purchase commitments
items.summary_md: CNBC (Nov 2 filing coverage still driving AI tape): $33.24B revenue for 9 months (+~1,200% YoY); Q3 ~$17B (+47% QoQ, slower than prior quarters); $104B nine-month net loss mostly fair-value of convertibles.

items.headline_md: Midterms ripple: AI/data-center backlash + Musk “data centers in space” quip
items.summary_md: CNBC: AI/data-center restrictions were a campaign issue; Amazon/Alphabet/Nvidia recovered from earlier declines despite state-level buildout concerns after the blue wave.

items.headline_md: **Reddit** begins testing **search-page ads** after login-wall shift
items.summary_md: AdExchanger: contextual search ads (e.g. “espresso station”); Reddit cited Google AI Overviews crushing referral traffic while its own ad run-rate topped $3B.

items.headline_md: **Apple** App Store: dating apps + AI companions restricted to **18+**
items.summary_md: AdExchanger roundup citing TechCrunch: policy tweak limits those categories to adult users.

items.headline_md: **Netflix** launching **AI Discover** recommendation interface
items.summary_md: AdExchanger cites THR: new AI Discover UI for more targeted content recommendations.

items.headline_md: Publishers say **Meta** ToS change opts sites into **AI scraping**
items.summary_md: AdExchanger cites Digiday: planned terms change would opt any site posting on Meta into AI scraping — publishers call it hostage-taking.

items.headline_md: US futures green after blue wave; Tue cash: Dow **51,787**, S&P **7,569**, Nasdaq **25,372**
items.summary_md: CNBC (6:29 a.m. EST Nov 4): Dow/S&P/Nasdaq futures rallied from overnight lows after Dems took Congress. Report.az (04.11.2026 09:05): Tue closes Dow 51,786.72 (−197), S&P 7,568.92 (+28), Nasdaq 25,372.01 (+208).

items.headline_md: Oil soft; gold higher — Brent **$102.80**, WTI **$95.15**, gold **$3,950.50**
**Bitcoin** ~**$78,300** after V-shaped rebound from sub-**$76k**
items.summary_md: CoinDesk (~3:37 a.m. EST update Nov 4): BTC erased early midterm-scare dip below $76k, trading ~$78,300 (~+1% day); election-day BTC options blocks ~$660M notional.

items.headline_md: **Nikkei** slides to **60,128** (−2,954); Europe soft; Shanghai **3,604** (−35)
**Phoenix AZ:** Wed sunny **77°F** / clear night **56°F** — precip **0%**, light SSW wind
items.summary_md: NWS PSR: sunny Wednesday high near 77 falling to ~74 afternoon; clear overnight low ~56; Wednesday precip chance 0%. No alerts in forecast text.

items.headline_md: **Show Low AZ:** Wed sunny **59°F** / mostly clear **34°F** — breezy SW gusts **~35 mph**
items.summary_md: NWS FGZ: sunny high near 59 falling to ~53 afternoon; SW wind 13–20 mph with gusts as high as 35; night low ~34; precip ~1%.

items.headline_md: **Snowflake AZ:** Wed sunny **65°F** / mostly clear **33°F** — SW gusts **~36 mph**
items.summary_md: NWS FGZ: sunny high near 65 falling to ~59 afternoon; SW 10–21 mph gusting to 36; night low ~33; precip ~1%.

items.headline_md: Ballotpedia Brew: full midterms map — Senate flips, trifectas, data-center recalls
items.summary_md: Why read: the cleanest single-page wrap of what actually flipped — seven Trump-won Senate seats, at least three new Dem trifectas, four governorship gains (TX/GA/IA/OH), and early notes on data-center recall elections — better than fragmented live blogs for Boyd’s morning scan.
